concerns.text: Task T017 (apply_prorl_rectification) depends on T016a (Greedy) and T016b (Beam), but T016b is marked [P] (parallel) while T016a is not. If T016b runs before T016a, T017 cannot execute as it requires the 'primary baseline' (Greedy) to calculate the batch mean (mu_batch) for SRC. The [P] tag on T016b is unsafe because it implicitly depends on the completion of T016a to define the 'batch' context for the rectification formula.

Task T025b (compare_metrics) depends on T024 (generate results/greedy_paths.json and results/greedy_rectified_paths.json). However, T024 is listed as an implementation task in Phase 4, while T025b is also in Phase 4. The dependency chain is broken: T025b cannot run until T024 produces the output files. T024 must be explicitly ordered before T025b, or T025b should be split into a 'logic' task (independent) and an 'orchestration' task (dependent on T024).

Task T030 (aggregate results) depends on T025b, T028b, and T029b. T028b and T029b are marked [P] (parallel) in the text description but are listed sequentially in the task list. More critically, T028b (execute_significance_test) requires the metric differences from T025b. If T028b is run in parallel with T025b (as implied by the [P] tag on T028b in the 'Parallel Opportunities' section), it will fail due to missing input data. The [P] tag on T028b is incorrect.

Tasks T013d-1, T013d-2, and T013d-3 are marked [P] (parallel). However, T013d-2 (data splitting) logically depends on T013d-1 (fetching sessions and extracting timestamps) because the split logic requires the timestamp column to be present. T013d-3 (error handling for empty test sets) depends on the result of T013d-2. These tasks form a strict sequence and cannot be parallelized. The [P] tags are semantically incorrect.
